Use case: stylized-concept. TRUE 2D 16-bit pixel art, manually clustered large square pixels and stair-step edges, hard limited palette, dusty purple-black backdrop with thin understated grid. Lime, vermilion, teal and warm gray, alternate per role. Think mechanical appliances and urban hazard machinery redesigned as sci-fi attackers. Crisp pixel number labels, no 3D lighting, blur or gradients.

Portrait game enemy concept sheet, exact 3 columns × 5 rows, 15 distinct full-body designs in numbered cells. Show numbers 01–15 once each in normal reading order, with no other text. 1024×1536. Clear separation, neutral consistent background, keep models inside cell boundaries. Elevated three-quarter view showing tops, pronounced silhouettes for a top-down arena. Each named concept is an original chassis and communicates an existing gameplay role. Preserve the prescribed body shapes; do not default to spiders, quadrupedal robot tanks, glowing chest orbs, giant fists, humanoid knights, guns on tripods, levitating torus portals or reactor crabs. Avoid recognizable existing IP.

Row 1: 01 a short upright roller with a forward rotating brush and red warning hood (basic); 02 a slim pogo-spring robot with one foot and twin swept fins (fast); 03 a tall squat concrete-compactor on two huge solid drums, presses down with a rectangular slab, no gun (heavy).
Row 2: 04 a hovering sideways satellite with a short recessed nozzle on one wing (shooter); 05 a red monowheel held by a pair of thick horizontal bull bars (charger); 06 a wheeled dynamite cart built around three striped rectangular explosive packs with a timer (bomber).
Row 3: 07 a mint-colored forklift carrying a first aid drawer marked + (repair); 08 a two-tone long train engine with two distinct front-facing cars joined at an energized hinge (splitter); 09 a rolling vending cabinet with two open side chutes and small emerging mini-drone outlines (summoner).
Row 4: 10 a very narrow wheeled gantry with a long horizontal railgun slung underneath (sniper); 11 a rounded dump truck whose back tilts up into a broad salvo launcher (mortar); 12 two perpendicular hovering rectangular frames crossing at a bright small square node (teleporter).
Row 5: 13 a squat tracked signal van with three telescoping dish antennas (buffer); 14 a wedge with a pivoting thick segmented bulldozer shield that covers the front (armored); 15 a huge tracked mobile assembly line with two overhead excavator arms and a long central ribbed motor topped by warning vents (arena boss, most massive).
